title: Rallies and blockades planned against Canon Francais banquet in Biarritz
seoTitle: Biarritz protest against Canon Francais banquet

tea.why: Opponents denounce the banquet as a disguised way to spread far-right ideas and point to previous racist insults and Nazi salutes.
tea.want: Organisers want to block access to the Halle d'Iraty, prevent attendees from reaching the banquet, and demand event cancellation.
tea.changed: Nov 26: Three collectives announced plans for multiple blockades and an antifascist march for November 28.

summary: Several collectives have called for protests, blockades, and a march against the upcoming Canon Francais banquet scheduled to take place at the Halle d'Iraty in Biarritz. Organisers from Herri Harresia, the Collectif contre le Canon français, and the mob antifa Iparralde plan to set up multiple gathering points to halt vehicle access and stage a separate antifascist demonstration. Protest representatives stated the actions aim to prevent attendees from entering the venue, while expecting tensions and preparing security teams. The banquet is linked to far-right investor Pierre-Édouard Stérin, with opponents citing racist remarks and Nazi salutes at prior editions. Conversely, supporters argue the events showcase French terroir and heritage. Local figures previously signed a manifesto and demonstrated outside the Bayonne sub-prefecture to demand the event's cancellation.
demands: Block access to the Halle d'Iraty venue
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Three collectives announced a series of blockades and a separate march in Biarritz ahead of the scheduled banquet.

sources.title: Canon français à Biarritz : trois points de blocage, une mobilisation annoncée et des tensions redoutées - ICI
